coverage_limits: I read each image third once at the supplied resolution and could not zoom or enhance. Consonants, word order, punctuation, parentheses, rubrics and English were checked in full. Vowels and dagesh were checked as far as the print is legible. Accents and meteg could not be checked reliably on these scans; no cantillation is printed in the scoped Hebrew, and none was looked for beyond the human-settled marks. Human-settled readings (זִכְרֹנֵֽנוּ וּפִקְדֹּנֵֽנוּ on s120, וִירוּשָׁלָֽ͏ִם on s124) agree with the print and were not reopened. The citation (נ״א כחֻק) belongs to s126, outside this scope, and was not reviewed. Acceptance is withheld for s124 until a human confirms the Et chil vowels listed as unresolved. On s118, s120 and s122, apart from the unresolved fine marks, I found no textual discrepancies. On s125 I found no discrepancies.
